subject: Penetration test report request and secure transfer logistics
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: sec-proc@acme.com
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Hi Monica,

Quick ask from Acme Security: can you provide the most recent penetration test report that covers Redwood's hosted API? We're primarily looking for:

- Executive summary and high-level findings
- Scope (external/internal, API endpoints, auth flows, cloud infra)
- Dates of testing and tester (redacted names are fine)
- Remediation status for critical/high findings

We have an internal checklist that needs the above as part of our SOC 2 annual re-assessment. For the full report, we can sign an NDA; otherwise an executive summary will suffice for this stage.

Also: what secure transfer options do you support? (SFTP, secure ShareFile link, S3 presigned with MFA, etc.)

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Security Engineer, Acme Corp

---
Acme Security (procurement): sec-proc@acme.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. We can share what you requested. High level notes up front: our most recent external penetration test that included the hosted API surface was completed in Nov 2025 by a third-party provider (external engagement). We can provide an executive summary and the remediations verification without an NDA. The full detailed report (with test steps and PoCs) requires an executed NDA and controlled delivery.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Scope: external network + hosted API endpoints (auth, token exchange, streaming endpoints). No internal-only management plane or customer data stores were in scope.
- Tested components: API gateway, token validation endpoints, session handling, public model inference endpoints.
- Test date: Nov 10–14, 2025. Tester: Redacted (3rd-party pen test firm listed in summary).
- Remediation status: all Critical findings (2 items) were remediated and verified by re-test in Jan 2026; High/Medium items have planned rollouts and an accompanying tracker.

For secure delivery we can do either:
1) Temporary ShareFile link (expiring, password protected) — preferred for summary + remediation tracker.
2) S3 pre-signed URL with MFA token via our engineering portal (requires registered contact).
3) Encrypted email attachment (PGP) if you'd provide a public key.

I'll attach the executive summary and a small remediation tracker export to get you started. If you'd like the full report, I can route the NDA via DocuSign and once executed we'll provide the full PDF via ShareFile with additional access controls.

Attached: [Attachment: redwood-pen-test-summary-202511.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through the remediation items; propose a 30-minute slot next week.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales (Security Lead)
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: sec-proc@acme.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for latest penetration test report (hosted API)

Thanks Monica — that helps. A couple of follow-ups: 

1) Would it be possible to get a short remediation summary table that lists each Critical/High finding, the mitigation implemented, and verification evidence (ticket IDs, patch dates)? We don't need PoCs in that table, just status and references.

2) For the full report, we'll sign your standard NDA. Please send the DocuSign link and we'll expedite signature.

3) ShareFile is fine for the summary — please set expiry to 14 days and include a download limit if possible. Also set a password and email it separately.

If it's easier to review together, can we do a 30-minute call Tue 3/2 at 10:00 PT? I'll include our InfoSec manager as well.

Jordan —

Thanks — we've set up the artifacts and scheduled a call. Summary of what I attached / sent:

- remediation-tracker-cv-list-202602.csv [Attachment stub: CSV, 24KB] — matches the table you asked for (finding id, severity, mitigation, verification ticket).
- access-instructions.txt [Attachment stub: TXT] — one-time password instructions and ShareFile access window.

ShareFile delivery: https://redwood.sharefile.com/s/EXAMPLE-pen-test (link expires 2026-03-16). Password will be sent in a separate email from security@redwood.ai in ~10 minutes. Download limit: 5 downloads.

For the full report we opened a DocuSign NDA: DocuSign link included in related links. Once signed, we'll provision a restricted view of the full PDF (read-only, watermarked) and a second, time-limited download if requested. Redactions will be applied to tester PII and internal ticket references per our policy.

Call scheduled: Tue 3/2 at 10:00 PT (30 minutes). Dial-in and calendar invite sent separately. Please add any internal stakeholders on your side; we've included Rishi (security) and Rachel (legal) from our team.

If you want any additional slices (for example, only endpoints but not rate-limiting test details), call that out and we can prepare a pared-down bundle.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales (Security Lead)
Redwood Inference
